result.title: Small Heads, Strong Decisions: A Controlled Study of Typed-Decision Models
result.summary: In September 2026, TypeSafe announced Jev as the first model in its System One category: unstructured state goes in, and typed, calibrated decisions that software can use directly come out. Jev's architecture and training data are unpublished, but many open typed-decision models have followed, including Nimble, the Decision 1.0--3.0 family and Clef. They answer structured questions about a piece of text, such as a yes/no check, a choice among labelled options or a graded score, by reading the text with a language model and scoring the options with a small readout. Each pairs a different readout with a different backbone, training mix and recipe, so it is unclear which design choices matter. We re-implement five readouts and train all of them under one protocol: the same backbone, the same 15 public English training sources, the same recipe with a per-head learning-rate sweep, and the same seed. Our experiments demonstrate that: The complexity of the head does not affect accuracy: on Qwen3-0.6B every readout reaches 81.3--82.0\% in-domain accuracy, and a 0.5M-parameter cosine head, which scores each option by its cosine similarity to the question, matches the 27M-parameter joint schema head adapted from Clef in-domain at half its inference time. Reading all of a text's questions from one prompt also matches one prompt per question in accuracy, with 1.6 times faster inference and 2.1--2.5 times faster training on one H100. The backbone's size matters more than either choice: moving from Qwen3-0.6B to Qwen3-4B adds 4 points in-domain and 11 points on held-out sources, while the base, instruct and thinking checkpoints of the same model tie. We recommend spending effort on the backbone and keeping the head minimal.

AI.brief_summary: 该文在统一协议（同一 backbone、15 个英文训练源、同一 recipe 与 seed）下重新实现五种 typed-decision readout，比较读出头复杂度、把整段文本的多个问题放进同一 prompt、以及 backbone 规模对准确率和推理/训练耗时的影响，发现读出头复杂度基本不影响精度而 backbone 规模影响最大。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「极小读出头即可从隐藏状态读出校准决策」的结论可能为判断 latent 状态是否保留任务必要信息、以及区分读出头容量与表示质量提供诊断线索；单 prompt 批量提问的设定也可供核查 latent 证据复用与缓存、注意力结构带来的成本差异。研究方法与视觉多模态推理无直接关系，故仅作方法线索。
